name: FX_Shock

textures.channels: RGB straight colour (sRGB) + alpha; 4 x 4 frames of 512 px, row by row from the top left

flipbook.ground_line: the sprite's ground point is 5 % of the frame above its bottom edge; side view at 18 degrees

source_note: frames are computed by the build script (seeded, deterministic): numpy fields -> OpenVDB -> Cycles volume render; no .blend is kept
dresses: explosion 167, 0.42 s: a white-hot ball 2.6 m across that hollows into a ring of fire rolling out to 4 m over the ground and breaks into burning clumps with dark smoke
known_weaknesses: The motion is an analytic shape pushed through noise, not a fluid simulation: the ring does not curl as a real vortex ring would and there is no ground flash, debris or light on the scene (a point light is runtime work). A flipbook on a camera-facing card: it has no depth against the scene and casts no light.
